assumptions: Target site is a static-hosted site (or simple Node/Express) serving /public files.
No iframes allowed; games must be integrated via native canvas/DOM or WASM/JS.
All games must be singleplayer-only or configured to singleplayer mode.
For DOOM, use FreeDoom WADs (provided or downloaded) rather than copyrighted commercial WADs.

constraints.licenses: Only include FOSS code and Free assets; include attribution files.

games.name: DOOM (FreeDoom assets + WASM engine)
games.description: WASM/JS port of a DOOM engine paired with FreeDoom WAD files (singleplayer).

integration.notes: Prefer prebuilt WASM engine; if unavailable, add Emscripten build instructions to compile chocolate-doom or prboom-ng. Do NOT bundle proprietary WADs.

integration.init_example: Include the game's script on the page; it runs on load. Wrap in an explicit init(container) if embedding is required.
Include phaser runtime and demo script, mount to a container div.
Include script and expose a restart/init function if embedding.

file_changes: Add /public/games/<name>/ folders with game files and LICENSE
Add /public/games/index.html listing all games (title, description, link, thumbnail)
Add /README-games.md with usage and license notes
Optional: add a small server script to serve .wasm with correct MIME if required
Optional tests: smoke tests that load each game's index and check for main canvas element
verification: Open /games/index.html and confirm each link loads the game's page and shows a canvas or playable UI
For DOOM, verify FreeDoom WAD loads and the engine shows the main menu
Run a basic headless test (puppeteer) to load each game page and check for '#game-root' or a canvas element

ai_prompt: You are an expert automated developer. Implement the following into the repository's `public` folder so that each listed game is self-hosted, singleplayer, and does not use iframes. Use only FOSS code and FreeDoom for DOOM assets. Create folders, copy or build minimal working static files for each game, add `public/games/index.html` (game list), and add `README-games.md` documenting setup and license attributions. For DOOM, prefer a prebuilt WASM engine if available; if not available, add build instructions and a Dockerfile or Emscripten command to compile chocolate-doom/prboom into WASM. Add small smoke tests (puppeteer or Playwright) that load each game's page and assert presence of a canvas or `#game-root`. Return a JSON report describing created files, any external builds required, and how to run the verification steps. Be careful: do not include or bundle any proprietary WADs (Doom shareware/full). Use FreeDoom or instruct how to add user-provided WAD files. Output only structured JSON with keys: created_files[], build_commands[], test_commands[], notes.
notes: This file was generated to be sent to an automation agent or to serve as a specification for manual integration. Review licenses before bundling any assets.
